distanceMethods.estimate_z_ad: Estimated angular-diameter distance from the existing redshift using flat Lambda-CDM (H0=70 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m=0.3, Omega_Lambda=0.7).
distanceMethods.unresolved: No defensible distance was available in this pass.
distanceMethods.estimate_z_light_travel_0017: Light-travel distance from measured/retained redshift using flat Lambda-CDM (H0=70 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m=0.3, Omega_Lambda=0.7); angular-diameter distance is stored separately for physical-size calculations.

sizeMethods.approx_fov_upper: Approximate full-frame physical scale from distance x Hubble field-of-view angle in radians. This is an upper-bound proxy, not a claim that the target fills the image.
sizeMethods.unresolved: Distance and/or field of view was unavailable or unsuitable.

ageMethods.unresolved: Galaxy age requires object-specific stellar-population/literature evidence and is not inferred from distance or redshift.
